about: ZETAPHY Saphan MAINNET: the ZTPHY routes from ZETAPHY mainnet (3659) to Base (8453; owner decision 2026-11-14) and to the chains under "destinations" (BNB Smart Chain 56 and Arbitrum One 42161 open, Polygon PoS 137 prepared but disabled; owner decision 2026-11-16). Read by zetaphy-network/scripts/saphan-mainnet.js (plan / deploy / open / pause / agents; --route <chain>) and scripts/saphan-pool.js (the pools; --route <chain>). Public values only: no key, no secret. null = an owner input that is still missing (the plan lists them per chain; deploy refuses while one is missing). Runbook: docs/SAPHAN-MAINNET.md.

zetaphy.name: zetaphy
zetaphy.core: registry/chains/zetaphy/addresses.yaml (next to this file; written by the hyperlane CLI at the core step, then committed)

base.name: base
base.ownersAbout: the Base SimpleMultisig (guardian of the synthetic, proposer of the Base timelock). Default: the ZETAPHY guardian multisig's three owners (EOAs: the same keys sign on Base). Owner: confirm, or replace.

validators.about: OUR Hyperlane validators. zetaphyOrigin signs ZETAPHY -> Base messages (the ISM on the Base synthetic). baseOrigin signs Base -> ZETAPHY messages (the ISM on the ZETAPHY vault); mode 'ours' = our validator(s) also validate Base (a second validator process, setup-agents-mainnet.sh VALIDATE_BASE=yes), mode 'hyperlane' = use hyperlaneBaseDefault instead (Hyperlane's published 3-of-5, stronger, no extra process). Addresses come from setup-agents-mainnet.sh addresses on the agents machine.
validators.allowSingleValidatorDecision: owner decision 2026-11-16: 1 of 1 (one validator on the sentry) accepted, with the caps, the mint delay and the guardian veto as the bound; add a second validator machine later and raise the threshold.
validators.allowSingleValidatorAbout: a 1-of-1 ISM is refused unless this is true (owner flag): then one key on one machine can mint unbacked ZTPHY on Base (bounded by the caps and the delay).

limits.about: Whole ZTPHY. Big enough for the owner's first liquidity (2 x 1,000,000 ZTPHY in one day), small against the supply (1,000,000,000): at most 0.25% can ever be out. The way back is tighter (a forged release would drain the vault). Raising any of them is a 48 h timelock call; guardians can lower them at once.

deployer.about: a FRESH key used only for this deploy (the same address on ZETAPHY and Base), holding no role afterwards. Owner input: its address; the key stays in a keystore on the owner's machine (KEYFILE / --keystore), never in this repository.

liquidity.about: The owner's first pools on Base (scripts/saphan-pool.js). Amounts are owner inputs (2026-11-14: 0.0001 USD per ZTPHY; 2026-11-16: start with one pool, ZTPHY/USDC, 500,000 ZTPHY + 50 USDC; a USDT pool waits until the owner names the token, then add it here); edit them here.
liquidity.baseRecipientAbout: REQUIRED owner input: a Safe on Base (2 of 3, made at app.safe.global by the liquidity multisig's members) that receives the bridged ZTPHY, holds the USDC/USDT and owns the pool positions. NEVER the ZETAPHY multisig's 0x address: on Base nobody holds its key, coins sent there are lost.

destinations.about: More destination chains, one entry each, same design as Base: per chain a NEW ZetaphyTokenVault on ZETAPHY (its own lockCap and release limit), a NEW SaphanSyntheticToken + SimpleMultisig + ZetaphyTimelock + our ISM there, its own Safe, DEX and pools. A new EVM chain is only an entry here (verified addresses, source and commit in "sources"); no code change. "enabled": false = prepared only: every deploy step refuses it and the agents leave it out. null = an owner input still missing (plan lists it per chain).

limits.about: Whole ZTPHY, this route only (its own vault on ZETAPHY, its own synthetic). The pools need 500,000 in one day; every route together stays under 1% of the supply (the config refuses more). Raising is a 48 h timelock call; guardians lower at once.

liquidity.recipientAbout: OWNER INPUT: a Safe ON BNB Smart Chain that receives the bridged ZTPHY, holds the USDT and owns the pool position. The owner's Base Safe 0x08Da43D48f1f68587220768Faf5a00C28962Dc36 can be deployed at the same address on BSC (app.safe.global); it does not exist there until then, and `check --route bsc` reads it.

USDT.issuer: Binance-Peg BSC-USD: issued by Binance, not by Tether; Binance (its owner key) can mint more; worth 1 USD only while Binance honours the peg

USDC.issuer: Binance-Peg USD Coin: issued by Binance, not by Circle; Binance (its owner key) can mint more

pools.issuer: Binance-Peg BSC-USD (issued by Binance, which can mint it; not Tether)

costs.about: gas price in gwei (check bscscan.com/gastracker), BNB price only for the USD column, the relayer's minimum float in BNB

funding.about: OWNER INPUT: the BNB you will send to the deployer and the relayer on BSC (costs prints what it recommends at your gwei; the plan warns when an amount is below it). Buy BNB on Binance and withdraw on the "BSC (BEP20)" network.
